title: CapabilityProfile
description: Maps a device profile to supported operations, protocol priorities, and release-1 eligibility.

profileId.description: Unique stable identifier referenced from Device.capabilityProfileId.

deviceType.description: Device type this profile applies to. Null matches any type within the paradigm.

discoveryParadigm.description: Discovery paradigm this profile applies to.

supportedOperations.description: Operations this profile explicitly supports. Any operation not listed is denied.

additionalProperties.description: Ordered list of protocols to try. An empty array blocks delivery.

releaseEligible.description: Whether this profile is eligible for release-1 production use.

unsupportedReasons.description: Human-readable reasons why specific operations are not supported.
